title: Boring Notch: free NotchNook alternative
caption:
NotchNook charges $15 to turn your MacBook notch into a music player. Boring Notch does it for free 🎵

✅ Notch expands into music controls with a live visualizer
✅ Calendar and reminders right in the notch
✅ File shelf with AirDrop support
✅ Replaces the volume and brightness pop-ups

💻 Mac (macOS 14 Sonoma or later)
ℹ️ The app isn't signed by Apple, so the first launch needs a one-time bypass (the Homebrew install skips it). It's also still on release candidates for the next version. NotchNook's lifetime price is $15 (there's also a $2/month plan)

Comment "NOTCH" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
